testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 (UC2) as a patient or HCP.

step.actions: patient: A patient can fill out a satisfaction survey for one of their past office visits , view their previously entered responses , or change any responses they have previously made . A HCP can view the results of satisfaction surveys for their office visits . Patients can view aggregate results for HCPs in the system .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction
